author: Dataverse plugin base
name: Dataverse plugin tests
description: A test project for one plugin assembly, wired to the fake pipeline harness. Runs with 'dv test -a <assembly>'.

testsFor.description: The plugin assembly these tests cover, e.g. Contoso.Plugins. This is what 'dv test -a' matches on.

pkgVersion.description: Version of Dataverse.Plugins.Testing to reference. Ignored inside the base repo, which imports the harness by path instead. Defaults to '*'; pin it once you have a real feed.
